value.rationale: The complete graph K5 is a canonical first nonplanar Kuratowski graph; the transition from planar to nonplanar H2 is explicitly motivated by Ramos–Yun 2026, and the three-point case sits beyond the well-tabulated two-point regime. The new integral H2 freeness and 30-dimensional S5 character with trace -2 uniquely on double transpositions are finer than Betti numbers or the marginal ordered S5 character. They provide a natural finite benchmark and inequivalent homology module classification without inventing a general theorem. Limit: a single canonical graph and particle number.
